title: Creators Wilds
description: Creators Wilds is a sandbox modpack with some adventure and exploration elements. It also features the Create mod, with more than 25 addons available for it.
body:
## 📌 Description
The Creators Wilds is a modpack built around the Create mod, featuring adventure, exploration, and a touch of RPG and fantasy elements.
It contains more than 290 mods, including performance optimizers and numerous QoL additions.
If that weren’t enough, the modpack also includes over 20 Create addon mods, providing even more new content for the Create experience.

In the future, I plan to expand the modpack even further—so if anyone has a good idea, feel free to let me know, and I’ll see what I can do.

## 📂 CurseForge mods
- [AllTheLeaks (Memory Leak Fix)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/alltheleaks) - MIT
- [Catalogue](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/catalogue) - MIT
- [Clickable advancements](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/clickable-advancements) - ARR*
- [Client Crafting](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/client-crafting) - ARR*
- [Configured](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/configured) - LGPLv3
- [Cupboard](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/cupboard) - ARR*
- [Ecliptic Seasons: Bundles](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ecliptic-seasons-bundles) - ARR*
- [Ecliptic Seasons: MultiMod Patch](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ecliptic-seasons-multimod-patch) - ARR*
- [fix GPU memory leak](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fix-gpu-memory-leak) - ARR*
- [Framework](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/framework) - LGPLv2.1
- [Goblin Traders](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/goblin-traders) - MIT
- [Luggage](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/luggage) - MIT
- [Mighty Mail](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mighty-mail) - MIT
- [PackMenu](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/packmenu) - MIT
- [Placebo](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/placebo) - MIT
- [Raw's Visual keybinder](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/raws-visual-keybinder) - ARR*

_*Mods marked with a star are not included in the modpack itself. These mods will be automatically downloaded by [AutoPack-Director](https://modrinth.com/mod/autopack-director) during the first launch._

💻**Keybind settings:** _Before your first playthrough, it is recommended to check the keybindings for the mods, as I configured them according to my own keyboard layout._
